n02: He left you a debt… to the mafia.
n03: To pay it off, you burn the bakery across the street.
n05: But you never leave the family.
n06: Four days later, your kitchen light turns on.
n07: The godfather is sitting at your table.
n08: He places a photo: you, in front of the fire.
n10: The most voted choice decides episode two.
